about.title: A family-owned Gresham shop
paragraphs: Referral Automotive is a family-owned repair shop on NE Cleveland Ave, working on foreign and domestic cars and trucks.
We explain in detail what's causing your problem before we fix it, and we offer a military discount.

estimate.title: What's going on with your car?
estimate.text: Tell us what your vehicle is doing and we will get back to you. Or call (503) 667-4335 (Mon–Fri: 8am–6pm).
estimate.thanks: Thanks! We will get back to you soon to set up a time.

services.name: Brakes
services.blurb: Pads, rotors, lines and brake inspections.
services.intro: Grinding, squealing or a soft pedal? We inspect the whole brake system and fix what needs fixing.

services.name: Alignments
services.blurb: Straight steering and even tire wear.
services.intro: Pulling to one side or wearing tires unevenly? An alignment puts things back where they belong.

services.name: A/C & Heating
services.blurb: A/C recharges, compressors and heater problems.
services.intro: From a weak A/C to a failed compressor, we explain what's wrong and fix it.

services.name: Engine Repair
services.blurb: From misfires to major engine work.
